annotation.title_clean: Commission Regulation (EU) No 459/2011 of 12 May 2011 amending the Annex to Regulation (EC) No 631/2009 laying down detailed rules for the implementation of Annex I to Regulation (EC) No 78/2009 on the type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.title_en: Commission Regulation (EU) No 459/2011 of 12 May 2011 amending the Annex to Regulation (EC) No 631/2009 on type-approval of motor vehicles with regard to the protection of pedestrians and other vulnerable road users
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Regulation amending the technical annex of Regulation 631/2009 on type-approval of motor vehicles for pedestrian and vulnerable road user protection. It clarifies impactor test points, bumper test options, towing hook exemption and accelerometer specifications. Conventional vehicle safety; no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Amends test requirements in Annex to Regulation (EC) No 631/2009 on pedestrian protection
Allows manufacturer choice of test for bumper heights of 425–500 mm
Permits derogation for a 132 mm exemption zone at removable towing hooks
Clarifies headform test point positions on bonnet and windscreen
Impactor first natural frequency must exceed 5,000 Hz
